name: Oghma Stone Script
abilities: Oghma Stone Script: Oath of Intercept
passives: Living Grove — Oghma's Mastery: Oghma's Living Grove: a solo stance fuse that grows when the Titan uses roots, moonlit growth, and fae paths to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Oghma Stone Script is a colossal Tuatha guardian from Avalora. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Tuatha guardian office: oath/bodyguard law, interception, sacred threshold defense; Geasa: sacred taboos and binding conditions.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Oghma Stone Script shows silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.. Role silhouette must read as Guardian. Materials include moon silver, living oak bark, thorn vine, moss velvet, green-gold light, fae glass, crow black feather. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid generic elf, wood block giant, treehouse body, cute fairy wings, random Celtic clipart knots, Renaissance costume.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Oghma Sentinel Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Verdant damage at range 1; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from living terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Barrow Punishing Guard
abilityDetails.effect: Apply parry, brace, boss counter, intercept; also builds 10 Grove Pulse when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Oghma Stone Script: Oath of Intercept
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Grove Pulse to create a two-round battlefield rule around living terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Barrow Verdant Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Grove Pulse, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Tuatha Barrow Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Oghma Stone Script Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 armor and +2 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Oghma Grove Pulse Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Grove Pulse cap +20. At 80+ Grove Pulse, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Grove Pulse.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: counter bosses and protect survival windows
